macros.name: lenprint
macros.doc: The macro for printing lengths.

macros.name: np
macros.doc: Shortcut for \numprint (only available with package option np).

macros.name: npaddmissingzero
macros.doc: Switch on adding missings zeros before or after the decimal sign.

macros.name: npaddplus
macros.doc: Using the \npaddplus command or the package option addplus, a plus sign can be added to a number that is specified without a sign.

macros.name: npaddplusexponent
macros.doc: Add a plus to the exponent when it has no sign.

macros.name: npaddtolanguage
macros.doc: Adds the hLanguage definitionsi specified in argument two to the hLanguagei of argument one.

macros.name: npafternum
macros.doc: Puts text after the number in tabulars.

macros.name: npcelsiusseparator
macros.doc: Change the separator between number and °C.

macros.name: npdecimalsign
macros.doc: Change the decimal sign.

macros.name: npdefunit
macros.doc: The command \npdefunit{⟨unitname⟩}{⟨unit⟩}{⟨scale⟩} can be used to define new units or to redefine existing ones.

macros.name: npdegreeseparator
macros.doc: Change the separator between number and °.

macros.name: npdigits
macros.doc: Switch on aligned number printing with given digits before and after the decimal sign.

macros.name: npexponentdigits
macros.doc: Switch on aligned printing of the exponent.

macros.name: npfourdigitnosep
macros.doc: Switch off separating four-digit numbers.

macros.name: npfourdigitsep
macros.doc: Switch on separating four-digit numbers.

macros.name: nplpadding
macros.doc: This command sets the total counts of digits a number should contain.

macros.name: npmakebox
macros.doc: The \npmakebox is similar to the \makebox command but it takes a text as first optional argument instead of a length.

macros.name: npnoaddmissingzero
macros.doc: Switch off adding missings zeros before or after the decimal sign.

macros.name: npnoexponentdigits
macros.doc: Switch alignment off for the exponent.

macros.name: nppercentseparator
macros.doc: Change the separator between number and %.

macros.name: npproductsign
macros.doc: Change the product sign.

macros.name: nprounddigits
macros.doc: Define a command that sets a count of digits after which the number is rounded.

macros.name: npstyledefault
macros.doc: Set the default values for the separators.

macros.name: npthousandsep
macros.doc: Change the thousand separator.

macros.name: npthousandthpartsep
macros.doc: Change the thousand separator (only after the decimal sign).

macros.name: npunit
macros.doc: Sets the unit in tabulars.

macros.name: npunitseparator
macros.doc: Change the separator between a number and a unit.
